218464.overview: Welcome to the Game Grid! No one has ever escaped from its confines, and now you find yourself here, relentlessly attacked by waves of enemy warriors. Armed with a deadly disc, fight off your attackers while avoiding their own discs! Jam open doors to create escape routes, but be wary of the giant Identifier! You may never escape, but try to claim the high score before you fall!

473545.overview:
Ike is the best ice cream maker in town!  He is so good that his system of serviing ice cream is renowned all over the place.  Ike can whip up a ice cream cone or sundae with his eyes closed!  His skill is unparalled.

But, even he cannot o this alone.  So, he is hiring!  Can you help him by serving his special multi-scoop cones?  He has a tendency to match up scoops of the same color in multiple angles.  But, they are coming down a conveyor belt very fast!  You need split-second timing to get it done!  Are you up to it?

The Game:
"Ice Cream Ike" is a puzzle game where you have to match ice cream scoops on one or more of five cones in five vertical columns.  You can match three or more scoops of the same color in a row in the Standard Match game.  This can be done vertically, horizontally, or diagonally.

Or, you can play the catch games, where you have to either catch three of the same color scoops of ice cream, or catch seven scoops a one time.  You can choose up to siz flavors to match up with.

You have five chances to get it right.  If you miss a scoop, you lose a chance.  After five chances, the game is over and you will be fired from your job by Ike.
